fields.title: Getting Back to Active Life After Injury
fields.content: Rehabilitation after injuries is a comprehensive process that includes physical exercises, proper nutrition, and psychological support. It's important to gradually restore mobility under the guidance of a specialist.
fields.excerpt: Rehabilitation after injuries is a process to restore physical and mental well-being.

fields.title: Supporting Someone During Recovery
fields.content: Psychological support is crucial. Listening, celebrating small successes, and helping with daily tasks all contribute to faster recovery.
fields.excerpt: Psychological support helps people recover faster after injuries or surgeries.

fields.title: Physiotherapy: Exercises for Post-Surgery Recovery
fields.content: Regular physical exercises under a specialist's supervision help restore muscle strength and joint mobility after surgery. Start with light exercises and gradually increase the intensity.
fields.excerpt: Physiotherapy helps regain strength and mobility after surgeries.
